title: Navy has no original FLIR1 tape, only the leaked copy
summary: Mick West tells of Navy has no original FLIR1 tape, only the leaked copy, about 2004-2017 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The US military doesn't have the original. The one that they released is the same. It's the one that they got from the German FTP server and then they released it from the US Navy.

plain: Mick West, a well-known sceptic who analyses UFO videos, talks about a Navy fighter jet video known as FLIR1, named after the jet's heat-sensing infrared camera. He says the US military does not have the original recording. According to West, the version the Navy officially released is the very same copy that had earlier turned up on a German file-sharing server online, which matters because it would mean nobody can check the footage against a cleaner original.
